messages:
maria: heads-up, ran a batch of perf probes on flashv3 today; found a weird slowpath when head_dim % 8 != 0 for causal mode on sm90.

kevin: rough numbers?

maria: seqlen=512, batch=4, head_dim=14 -> v3 kernel picks but full-run latency 1.18x of v2. v2 stable and ~18% faster.

arjun: that matches something I saw — v3 prefetch stride assumes 16-aligned heads for its tile layout. when head_dim=14 we end up with padspill and extra memops.

maria: exact repro command: `python perf/run.py --device sm90 --model llama-7b --head-dim 14 --seqlen 512 --mode causal --runs 50`

nate: perf-bot flagged this earlier:
perf-bot: ALERT: regression-opsync detected (sm90, flashv3, causal). p50 latency +22% vs baseline (2026-11-02). Link: http://perf/reports/3567

kevin: can we short-circuit kernelpicker to prefer v2 for those head_dims? maybe add a cheap check in the selector.

arjun: we already do head_dim buckets but the bucket boundaries are too coarse. current rule: if head_dim <= 16 -> small-heads -> pick v3. need to switch to `head_dim % tile_width == 0` and fallback when not divisible.

maria: also noticed KV-cache warmup thrash when microbatching (microbatch=2) + causal + head_dim odd. KV cache fills inconsistently so first token latency spikes.

kevin: sounds like two problems: kernel choice heuristic and KV warmup pattern. propose a short-term fix: force v2 for (causal && head_dim % 8 != 0) and disable prefetch for those combos. longer-term: autotuner should probe aligned vs unaligned microbench.

arjun: I can add a quick heuristic patch. Psuedo:```
if mode == 'causal' and (head_dim % 8) != 0:
    prefer_kernel = 'flashv2'
    disable_prefetch = True
```

maria: please add a metric tag so perf pipeline can compare. tag: `kv-warmup-headodd`

nate: creating canary config now, will roll to dev1.

perf-bot: NOTE: canary experiment created by nate (canary/dev1). Experiment id: exp-356789. Monitoring p50/p95 and token throughput.

kevin: also add an autotune probe that runs at model load: tries small kernel microbench for the running head_dim/seqlen distribution and writes a pin to model metadata. don't block startup (async).

arjun: good call. will add a background probe: 3 microbatches per model load, measure latency and choose pinned kernel if clear >7% improvement.

maria: for follow-up: investigate if padspill impacts memory bandwidth on sm90 vs sm86 differently. file: `perf/notes/hothead-padspill-sm90.md` (internal).

nate: rolling canary in 5m. will post results.

maria: thanks — also adding a short repro case to unit tests to avoid regressions: `tests/perf/test_kernelpicker_head_repro.py` with the command above.

kevin: tidy plan -> 1) quick heuristic patch (arjun) 2) canary rollout (nate) 3) background autotune (kevin+arjun) 4) test + perf alert tag (maria). assign and ETA?

arjun: heuristic PR in next 2 hours.

maria: i'll author the test after that, ETA EOD.

nate: canary looks clean so far, p50 back to baseline on dev1. will update prod if green for 1 hour. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: EXPERIMENT_UPDATE: exp-356789 -> p50 delta: -1.5% (vs baseline), p95 delta: -0.8%. NOTE: canary ran with heuristic patch.

kevin: awesome, ship the heuristic and open a follow-up for autotune. :tada:
